discourse analysis. Ideology refers to ideas and beliefs that legitimize social issues. These beliefs legitimize political authority and the sets of actions that carry out practices. Ideology gains authority and legitimacy voluntarily without the use of force. Political and religious leaders align themselves with certain ideologies to achieve their goals because they understand that these ideologies are accepted by members of society. Change is inevitable, and as different sectors in society undergo change, leaders also adapt their leadership approaches. Likewise, as history changes, ideology also shifts within society. The article has explained the concept of ideology, clarified the types of ideology, and identified them in the plays Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004) and Kifo Kisimani (2001). Some of the types of ideology identified in the selected plays include religious ideology, liberation ideology, governance ideology, cultural ideology, feudal ideology, and capitalist ideology. These types have been identified through the discourse of characters and the context of their conversations. The research in this article is guided by the Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA) theory established by Norman Fairclough (1989). THEORY  
Ideology is a concept with many meanings. Eagleton (1991) has listed some descriptions of the concept of ideology as: the process of creating meaning, symbols, and values in society. Second, ideology is a collection of ideas held by a particular social group or class. Third, ideology consists of ideas or beliefs that legitimize political authority and the sets of actions that carry out practices. Eagleton (1991) further explains that ideology derives its meaning from historical changes. Marx and Engels (1977) define ideology as all human ideas and views regarding what they say and think about religion, law, politics, economics, and morals. Ideology guides how an author depicts themes and their intention. Ideology directs a person to perform good or bad actions (Murithi, 2017). Writing styles and methods have ideological effects, as noted by Fairclough (2001). This article is guided by the theory of Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA). The CDA theory was founded by Norman Fairclough (1989) at the Lancaster School of Linguistics. Key proponents of this theory include Wodak (1997) and Dijk (1998). According to Wodak (1997), CDA focuses on ideology and governance based on written, visual, and spoken data. Wodak states that CDA regards language as a social act and considers the context of language to be very important. Fairclough (2001) explains that CDA is a crucial social science that examines the problems people face due to specific social circumstances and how to avoid those problems. He further explains that the concept of discourse is guided by ideology. The pillars of CDA that guided the research for this article are: ideology, culture, discourse, levels of analysis, and the structure of society. Research Methodology

Religious Ideology  
Davis (1994) describes religion as a social practice. Therefore, religion influences society by setting criteria for judging what humans do within society. He further explains that religion emphasizes that not everything a human thinks and does is good and valuable. Religious beliefs in society create controversy when interpreting worldly matters outside the realm of spiritual understanding. Religion shows that the social order was not established by humans, but by a being beyond them. This belief is passed down from one generation to another as part of culture. Davis (1994) shows the use of political language and the misuse of religious language in politics. Politicians use the religious system that guides humans to oppress others. He gives the example of the Israelites, who were granted the holy land by God. They used the belief of being given land by God to legitimize their actions and their situation, especially toward the Palestinians. Even Israelites who did not value the things of God used the notion of ‘being given land by God’ as a justification for themselves. Religion has many meanings depending on the perspectives of various scholars. Cosmstock (1984) defines religion as that which is sacred, the commitment to promoting good deeds, love for humanity, and faith in deities. He goes on to explain that religion is what we practice unseen and which preserves society. Additionally, Schilbrack (2013) describes religion as a concept that solves problems. But what are the problems that define religious actions when they are being resolved? According to Fitzgerald (2011), religion generally refers to a distinctive belief about human experience and institutions. He considers religion as matters of spirituality and the ‘other world’. It is a belief in supernatural powers. Religion is love, peace, does not condone violence, and does not engage in politics. Fitzgerald mentions some types of religion such as Christianity, Hinduism, Islam, and Buddhism. These religions are guided by different ideologies. According to various scholars, religion is a social practice involving spiritual matters and belief in a being greater than humans. Human actions are guided by the faith they have in this higher being. Plamenatz (1970), Davis (1994), and Cavanaugh (2009) regard religious ideology as a belief used to mislead human beings. The social order established by a being superior to humans is used to conceal the inner nature of humans and to make them believe that they are victims of forces beyond their control. The perspective of the playwright in Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi and Kifo Kisimani aligns with the ideas of Plamenatz, Davis, and Cavanaugh in the way he portrays the beliefs of the characters based on the context of dialogue and expressions guided by ideology. The playwright demonstrates how the characters perpetuate violence and oppress others on the basis of religious ideology. His perspective is that religion is used to sustain bad leadership and mislead members of society from liberating themselves from oppression. According to Eddins (1972), liberation is a political ideology that provides guidance for the formulation of public policies. Liberators believe that the main goal of public policy is to protect the rights of the oppressed and ensure equality of growth and full self-development. Furthermore, Gramsci (1994) explains that it is difficult to attain liberation. Those in need of liberation have been assigned roles by society ‘for the benefit of all’. They have become accustomed to these roles and view them as normal. Gramsci goes on to explain that members of society need to recognize and understand their place in history, their rights, and their responsibilities. He emphasizes the importance of education in achieving liberation and the need for education in democracy. For him, education enables society to control the forces that govern them and to attain liberation, although it will take a long time to achieve liberation. Liberation Ideology  
According to Montero (2009), liberation is a process that involves social transformation aimed at promoting equality, opposing oppression and injustice. Liberation also eliminates institutions that perpetuate these evils. Montero (already cited) explains that liberation is directed towards social sectors that are oppressed. Liberation aims to raise people's awareness of their rights and the importance of living in an equal and democratic society. Given the various interpretations of the concept of the ideology of liberation, it is clear that liberation addresses the rights of people who have been oppressed by their leaders. The goal of liberation is to give them freedom and the ability to advance themselves in all aspects of life. The ideology of liberation upholds the belief in freeing oneself from bad leadership. Groups that adhere to this belief implement this process by advancing revolutions against poor leadership. Kitto (2019) explains that revolution is an important step to help society achieve development for the lower classes by removing the upper class from power and creating a classless society. Revolutionaries abolish the capitalist system and establish socialism. Njogu (1997) explains that a revolution can occur if those in power do not take into account various social circumstances, either due to neglect or indifference. Pavkovic (2005) describes the ideology of liberation as a set of beliefs, value judgments, and guidelines that direct political actions with the aim of liberating an oppressed group from their oppressors. To control the oppressed, oppressors employ brutal methods. He goes on to explain that the oppressed use force and violence to free themselves from the cruelty of their oppressors. Governance Ideology  
According to Tangus and Sang (2020), governance is a system that defines the structures used by organizations or leaders. It is a system that establishes principles for the protection of rights and has responsibilities to ensure that the management of all societal affairs is effective. They go on to explain that it is important for the governance system to address all levels of society, politics, and the economy. Based on the various definitions of the concept of governance, it is clear that governance ideology involves the exercise of authority to improve and strengthen all social, political, and economic spheres. Leaders are required to promote good governance that advocates for and protects the rights of community members and ensures equity in the distribution of community resources. There is a strong relationship between discourse, culture, and society according to Fairclough (1989). Discourse embodies the culture of the particular society. The playwright of "Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi" (2004) has depicted the issue of culture through the lineage that arises from marriage. The discussions of bride price and marriage mentioned are cultural issues within the African community. According to Nsereko (1975), paying bride price is a custom in which a man is required to give property to the wife's family before marriage. This is a gesture of gratitude to those who took care of the wife. Dowry strengthens marriage and legitimizes the union between the families involved. Some of the phrases used in the selected play to indicate this culture are: marriage, dowry, and wedding. Mijadala, ubepari, uchambuzi muhimu wa mijadala. Itikadi inahusu mawazo na imani ambazo zinahalalisha masuala ya kijamii. Imani hizi zinahalalisha mamlaka ya kisiasa na vitendo vinavyotekeleza mazoea hayo. Itikadi hupata mamlaka na uhalali kwa hiari bila matumizi ya nguvu. Viongozi wa kisiasa na kidini hujiunga na itikadi fulani ili kufikia malengo yao kwa sababu wanaelewa kwamba itikadi hizi zinakubalika na wanajamii. Mabadiliko hayakwepeki, na sekta mbalimbali katika jamii zinapopitia mabadiliko, viongozi pia hubadilisha mbinu zao za uongozi. Vivyo hivyo, historia inavyobadilika, itikadi pia hubadilika ndani ya jamii. Makala imeelezea dhana ya itikadi, kufafanua aina za itikadi, na kuzitambua katika tamthilia Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004) na Kifo Kisimani (2001). NADHARIA  
Itikadi ni dhana yenye maana nyingi. Eagleton (1991) ametaja baadhi ya maelezo ya dhana ya itikadi kama: mchakato wa kuunda maana, alama, na maadili katika jamii. Pili, itikadi ni mkusanyiko wa mawazo yanayoshikiliwa na kundi fulani la kijamii au tabaka. Tatu, itikadi inajumuisha mawazo au imani zinazohalalisha mamlaka ya kisiasa na seti za vitendo vinavyotekeleza mazoea. Eagleton (1991) anaeleza zaidi kuwa itikadi inapata maana yake kutokana na mabadiliko ya kihistoria. Marx na Engels (1977) wanafafanua itikadi kama mawazo na mitazamo yote ya mwanadamu kuhusu wanachosema na kufikiria juu ya dini, sheria, siasa, uchumi, na maadili. Itikadi inaongoza jinsi mwandishi anavyoonyesha mada na nia zao. Itikadi humwelekeza mtu kufanya matendo mema au mabaya (Murithi, 2017). Mitindo na mbinu za uandishi zina athari za kiitikadi, kama ilivyoanishwa na Fairclough (2001). Makala hii inaongozwa na nadharia ya Uchambuzi Hakiki wa Usemi (CDA). Nadharia ya CDA ilianzishwa na Norman Fairclough (1989) katika Shule ya Isimu ya Lancaster. Watetezi wakuu wa nadharia hii ni pamoja na Wodak (1997) na Dijk (1998). Kulingana na Wodak (1997), CDA inazingatia itikadi na utawala kulingana na data iliyoandikwa, inayoonekana, na inayozungumzwa. Wodak anaeleza kuwa CDA huchukulia lugha kama kitendo cha kijamii na huchukulia muktadha wa lugha kuwa muhimu sana. Fairclough (2001) anaeleza kuwa CDA ni sayansi ya kijamii muhimu inayochunguza matatizo wanayokabiliana nayo watu kutokana na hali maalum za kijamii na jinsi ya kuepuka matatizo hayo. Anafafanua zaidi kwamba dhana ya mazungumzo inaongozwa na itikadi. Nguzo za CDA zilizoliongoza utafiti wa makala hii ni: itikadi, utamaduni, usemi, viwango vya uchambuzi, na muundo wa jamii. Mbinu za Utafiti  
Utafiti wa makala hii ulifanyika katika maktaba. Watafiti walisoma tamthilia zilizochaguliwa Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi na Kifo Kisimani. Zaidi ya hayo, walishauriana na vitabu na kupitia makala za mtandaoni zinazohusiana na malengo ya makala hii. Dhima na aina za itikadi zimebainishwa kulingana na muundo wa maelezo. Michezo iliyochaguliwa iliteuliwa kwa makusudi kutokana na uwepo wa itikadi katika michezo iliyochaguliwa ya Kifo Kisimani na Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi ya Kithaka wa Mberia. . Dhana la itikadi limeelezwa, na aina za itikadi zimetajwa na kufafanuliwa kwa undani. Aina za itikadi katika mchezo ulioteuliwa zimetambuliwa kulingana na vipengele vya muktadha wa mazungumzo, hotuba, na matumizi ya lugha. Vipengele hivi vimewawezesha watafiti kubaini mada ambazo zinaonyesha wazi aina za itikadi. Aina za itikadi zilizotambulika katika tamthilia zilizochaguliwa ni pamoja na: itikadi ya kidini, ukombozi, uongozi. Data iliyokusanywa ilichambuliwa na kuwasilishwa kwa njia ya maelezo. MATOKEO YA UTAFITI NA MAJADILIANO  
Katika sehemu hii, aina za itikadi zimefafanuliwa na kutambulishwa kutoka katika tamthilia zilizochaguliwa. Aina za itikadi zilizobainishwa katika tamthilia hizi ni pamoja na: itikadi ya kidini, ukombozi, utawala, itikadi ya kitamaduni, itikadi ya kifalme, na itikadi ya kibepari. aina za itikadi zilizoorodheshwa zinatokana na mawazo ya jumla ya wasomi mbalimbali.

Anderson anachukulia ubepari kama mfumo unaohusisha maendeleo ya kiuchumi yanayotokana na upanuzi wa mbinu fulani za uzalishaji. Kulingana na Holton (1985), kuibuka kwa mbinu za uzalishaji za kibepari na ukuaji wake wakati wa enzi ya viwanda kulitegemea mbinu zilizokuwepo awali. Anaendelea kueleza kuwa ubepari si ishara ya uhuru wa kiuchumi bali ni ishara ya unyonyaji na mapambano ya madaraka katika nyanja ya uzalishaji. Ubepari ni mfumo wa kiuchumi, kisiasa na kijamii unaojulikana na umiliki binafsi wa mali, biashara na viwanda kwa lengo la kupata faida kubwa kwa manufaa ya watu fulani. Wabepari hutumia wahitimu kuhudumia maslahi yao wenyewe. Laclau (1979) anasema kwamba ubepari unahusisha yafuatayo: mfumo wa uzalishaji kwa ajili ya soko, faida kama nguvu ya kuendesha uzalishaji, na hatimaye, faida hii inapatikana kwa manufaa ya mtu mwingine tofauti na mtayarishaji. Katika tamthilia ya Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004), kupitia mazungumzo kati ya Gachono, Nyagachi, na Kabitho, tunaona jinsi uchumi umezorota. Kuzingatia viwango vya uchambuzi vinavyoangazia muktadha wa mahusiano ya kijamii ambayo huathiri mazungumzo, maneno yanayoonyesha hali duni ya tabaka la chini hutumika. Uwepo wa viroboto, uhaba wa chakula, na vifo vya wanawake na watoto ni matokeo ya watu fulani kujilimbikizia utajiri wa umma kwa manufaa yao binafsi. Ni desturi kuwa na hati ya umiliki wa ardhi kama ushahidi kwamba ardhi inamilikiwa na mtu fulani. Mtazamo wa mwandishi wa tamthilia ya Kifo Kisimani na Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004) kuhusu itikadi ya ubepari unaonyesha maendeleo ya kiuchumi, kijamii, na kisiasa ya mtu binafsi (Holton, 1985). Mwandishi ameonyesha mtazamo hasi dhidi ya mfumo wa kibepari kulingana na jinsi anavyotumia lugha kuangazia ubinafsi wa baadhi ya wahusika katika maendeleo yao binafsi. Mfumo wa kiuchumi na kijamii unapaswa kuwafaidi wanachama wote wa jamii. Zaidi ya hayo, katika tamthilia ya Kifo Kisimani, kinyume chake ndicho kweli. Wabepari hunufaika na mitiririko yote ya kijamii, kiuchumi, na kisiasa (Amin, 2011). Majadiliano ni kitendo cha kijamii (Dijk, 1993); kutoka kwa matamshi ya Andua, tunatambua jinsi itikadi ya ubepari inavyoendelezwa. Wakazi wa kijiji hawaruhusiwi kuchota maji kutoka kisima cha Mkuyuni. Kulingana na mazungumzo kati ya Andua na Tanya (UK 49), inadhihirika kwamba maji kutoka kwenye bwawa, ambayo yanapaswa kutumiwa kwa manufaa ya binadamu, yameachwa kwa ng'ombe wa mwana wa chifu. Badala ya kuchotea maji kwa ajili ya mifugo, wanaruhusiwa kuingia ndani ili waweze kunywa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye bwawa. INTRODUCTION  
Cultural ideology, feudal ideology, and capitalist ideology  
THEORY  
Ideology is a concept with many meanings. Eagleton (1991) has listed some descriptions of the concept of ideology as: the process of creating meaning, symbols, and values in society. Second, ideology is a collection of ideas held by a particular social group or class. Third, ideology consists of ideas or beliefs that legitimize political authority and the sets of actions that carry out practices. Eagleton (1991) further explains that ideology derives its meaning from historical changes. Marx and Engels (1977) define ideology as all human ideas and views regarding what they say and think about religion, law, politics, economics, and morals. Ideology guides how an author depicts themes and their intention. Ideology directs a person to perform good or bad actions (Murithi, 2017). Writing styles and methods have ideological effects, as noted by Fairclough (2001).
discourses.translated_txt:
UTANGULIZI  
Itikadi ya kitamaduni, itikadi ya kifedha, na itikadi ya kibepari  
NADHARIA  
Itikadi ni dhana yenye maana nyingi. Eagleton (1991) ametaja baadhi ya maelezo ya dhana ya itikadi kama: mchakato wa kuunda maana, alama, na maadili katika jamii. Pili, itikadi ni mkusanyiko wa mawazo yanayoshikiliwa na kundi fulani la kijamii au tabaka. Tatu, itikadi inajumuisha mawazo au imani zinazohalalisha mamlaka ya kisiasa na seti za vitendo vinavyotekeleza mazoea. Eagleton (1991) anaeleza zaidi kuwa itikadi inapata maana yake kutokana na mabadiliko ya kihistoria. Marx na Engels (1977) wanafafanua itikadi kama mawazo na mitazamo yote ya mwanadamu kuhusu wanachosema na kufikiria juu ya dini, sheria, siasa, uchumi, na maadili. Itikadi inaongoza jinsi mwandishi anavyoonyesha mada na nia zao. Itikadi humwelekeza mtu kufanya matendo mema au mabaya (Murithi, 2017). Mitindo na mbinu za uandishi zina athari za kiitikadi, kama ilivyoanishwa na Fairclough (2001).

discourses.source_txt: This article is guided by the theory of Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA). The CDA theory was founded by Norman Fairclough (1989) at the Lancaster School of Linguistics. Key proponents of this theory include Wodak (1997) and Dijk (1998). According to Wodak (1997), CDA focuses on ideology and governance based on written, visual, and spoken data. Wodak states that CDA regards language as a social act and considers the context of language to be very important. Fairclough (2001) explains that CDA is a crucial social science that examines the problems people face due to specific social circumstances and how to avoid those problems.
discourses.translated_txt: Makala hii inaongozwa na nadharia ya Uchambuzi Hakiki wa Usemi (CDA). Nadharia ya CDA ilianzishwa na Norman Fairclough (1989) katika Shule ya Isimu ya Lancaster. Watetezi wakuu wa nadharia hii ni pamoja na Wodak (1997) na Dijk (1998). Kulingana na Wodak (1997), CDA inazingatia itikadi na utawala kulingana na data iliyoandikwa, inayoonekana, na inayozungumzwa. Wodak anaeleza kuwa CDA huchukulia lugha kama kitendo cha kijamii na huchukulia muktadha wa lugha kuwa muhimu sana. Fairclough (2001) anaeleza kuwa CDA ni sayansi ya kijamii muhimu inayochunguza matatizo wanayokabiliana nayo watu kutokana na hali maalum za kijamii na jinsi ya kuepuka matatizo hayo.

RESEARCH FINDINGS AND DISCUSSION  
In this section, the types of ideology are clarified and identified from the selected plays. The types of ideology identified in the selected plays include: religious ideology, liberation, governance, cultural ideology, feudal ideology, and capitalist ideology. The types of ideology listed are based on the general ideas of various scholars.  

Religious Ideology  
Davis (1994) describes religion as a social practice. Therefore, religion influences society by setting criteria for judging what humans do within society. He further explains that religion emphasizes that not everything a human thinks and does is good and valuable. Religious beliefs in society create controversy when interpreting worldly matters outside the realm of spiritual understanding. Religion shows that the social order was not established by humans, but by a being beyond them. This belief is passed down from one generation to another as part of culture.

MATOKEO YA UTAFITI NA MAJADILIANO  
Katika sehemu hii, aina za itikadi zimefafanuliwa na kutambulishwa kutoka katika tamthilia zilizochaguliwa. Aina za itikadi zilizobainishwa katika tamthilia hizi ni pamoja na: itikadi ya kidini, ukombozi, utawala, itikadi ya kitamaduni, itikadi ya kifalme, na itikadi ya kibepari. aina za itikadi zilizoorodheshwa zinatokana na mawazo ya jumla ya wasomi mbalimbali.

Itikadi ya Kidini  
Davis (1994) anaelezea dini kama tendo la kijamii. Hivyo basi, dini inaathiri jamii kwa kuweka vigezo vya kupima kile ambacho binadamu wanafanya katika jamii. Anafafanua zaidi kwamba dini inasisitiza kuwa si kila kitu ambacho binadamu anafikiria na kufanya ni chema na cha thamani. Imani za kidini katika jamii huleta mijadala mikali wakati wa kutafsiri mambo ya kidunia nje ya uelewa wa kiroho. Dini inaonyesha kwamba mpangilio wa kijamii haukuanzishwa na binadamu, bali na kiumbe kilicho juu yao. Imani hii hupitishwa kutoka kizazi kimoja hadi kingine kama sehemu ya utamaduni.

discourses.source_txt: Liberation aims to raise people's awareness of their rights and the importance of living in an equal and democratic society. Given the various interpretations of the concept of the ideology of liberation, it is clear that liberation addresses the rights of people who have been oppressed by their leaders. The goal of liberation is to give them freedom and the ability to advance themselves in all aspects of life. The ideology of liberation upholds the belief in freeing oneself from bad leadership. Groups that adhere to this belief implement this process by advancing revolutions against poor leadership.
discourses.translated_txt: Ukombozi unalenga kuongeza uelewa wa watu kuhusu haki zao na umuhimu wa kuishi katika jamii yenye usawa na demokrasia. discourses.source_txt: The perspective of the playwright of Kifo Kisimani and Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004) regarding the ideology of capitalism points to individual economic, social, and political advancement (Holton, 1985). The playwright has demonstrated a negative attitude towards the capitalist system based on the way he uses language to emphasize the selfishness of some characters in their personal advancement.
discourses.translated_txt: Mtazamo wa mwandishi wa tamthilia ya Kifo Kisimani na Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004) kuhusu itikadi ya ubepari unaonyesha maendeleo ya kiuchumi, kijamii, na kisiasa ya mtu binafsi (Holton, 1985). Mwandishi ameonyesha mtazamo hasi dhidi ya mfumo wa kibepari kulingana na jinsi anavyotumia lugha kuangazia ubinafsi wa baadhi ya wahusika katika maendeleo yao binafsi.

discourses.source_txt: Capitalists do not care about the interests of others, only their own. They are driven by the profits obtained from the production and distribution of goods and services.
discourses.translated_txt: Wabepari hawajali maslahi ya wengine, bali yao tu. Wanaongozwa na faida wanazopata kutokana na uzalishaji na usambazaji wa bidhaa na huduma.

discourses.source_txt: The author has shown how members of society are affected by this system that hinders human civilization (Amin, 2011).
discourses.translated_txt: Mwandishi ameonyesha jinsi wanachama wa jamii wanaathiriwa na mfumo huu unaokwamisha ustaarabu wa binadamu (Amin, 2011).

discourses.source_txt:
CONCLUSION
The economic and social system should benefit all members of society.
discourses.translated_txt:
HITIMISHO
Mfumo wa kiuchumi na kijamii unapaswa kuwafaidi wanachama wote wa jamii.

discourses.source_txt: Moreover, in the play Kifo Kisimani, the opposite is true. The capitalists benefit from all social, economic, and political streams (Amin, 2011).
discourses.translated_txt: Zaidi ya hayo, katika tamthilia ya Kifo Kisimani, kinyume chake ndicho kweli. Wabepari hunufaika na mitiririko yote ya kijamii, kiuchumi, na kisiasa (Amin, 2011).

discourses.source_txt: Discourse is a social act (Dijk, 1993); from Andua's utterance, we recognize how the ideology of capitalism is perpetuated.
discourses.translated_txt: Majadiliano ni kitendo cha kijamii (Dijk, 1993); kutoka kwa matamshi ya Andua, tunatambua jinsi itikadi ya ubepari inavyoendelezwa.

discourses.source_txt: The villagers are not allowed to fetch water from the Mkuyuni well.
discourses.translated_txt: Wakazi wa kijiji hawaruhusiwi kuchota maji kutoka kisima cha Mkuyuni.

discourses.source_txt: Based on the conversation between Andua and Tanya (UK 49), it becomes evident that the water from the reservoir, which should be used for human benefit, has been left for the chief’s son’s cattle.
discourses.translated_txt: Kulingana na mazungumzo kati ya Andua na Tanya (UK 49), inadhihirika kwamba maji kutoka kwenye bwawa, ambayo yanapaswa kutumiwa kwa manufaa ya binadamu, yameachwa kwa ng'ombe wa mwana wa chifu.

discourses.source_txt: Instead of fetching water for the cattle, they are released inside so they can drink directly from the reservoir. Andua explains how the guards beat them because they fetched water from the well, and one of them pushed him, causing him to fall onto a stone and get injured.
discourses.translated_txt: Badala ya kuchotea maji kwa ajili ya mifugo, wanaruhusiwa kuingia ndani ili waweze kunywa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye bwawa. Andua anaeleza jinsi walinzi walivyowapiga kwa sababu walichota maji kutoka kwenye kisima, na mmoja wao alimsukuma, akamfanya aanguke juu ya jiwe na kuumia.

discourses.source_txt: In this article, the concept of ideology is defined as all the thoughts and opinions of human beings regarding what they say and think about political, social, and economic issues. The types of ideologies have been identified in the plays Kifo Kisimani (2001) and Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004).
discourses.translated_txt: Katika makala hii, dhana ya itikadi inafasiriwa kama mawazo na maoni yote ya binadamu kuhusu yale wanayosema na kufikiria kuhusu masuala ya kisiasa, kijamii, na kiuchumi. Aina za itikadi zimetambulika katika tamthilia za Kifo Kisimani (2001) na Maua kwenye Jua la Asubuhi (2004).

discourses.source_txt: Some of the types of ideology identified are religious, governance, cultural, feudal, capitalist, and liberation ideologies. Researchers have demonstrated the types of ideology by focusing on the context of conversations, speech, content, and the relationships that exist between characters.
discourses.translated_txt: Baadhi ya aina za itikadi zilizotambuliwa ni za kidini, utawala, kitamaduni, kifalme, kibepari, na itikadi za ukombozi. Watafiti wameonyesha aina hizi za itikadi kwa kuzingatia muktadha wa mazungumzo, hotuba, maudhui, na mahusiano yaliyopo kati ya wahusika.

discourses.source_txt: Beliefs in society about living conditions are manifested in the speech of characters. Speech is a type of social act. In the play “Kifo Kisimani” (2001), Gege’s speech signifies a social act of amassing wealth without caring for others.
discourses.translated_txt: Imani katika jamii kuhusu hali za maisha zinaonekana katika usemi wa wahusika. Usemi ni aina ya tendo la kijamii. Katika tamthilia ya "Kifo Kisimani" (2001), usemi wa Gege unaashiria tendo la kijamii la kujilimbikizia mali bila kujali wengine.

discourses.source_txt: His speech aligns with Anderson’s (1979) ideas, who explains that capitalism involves personal advancement in economic, political, and social spheres.
discourses.translated_txt: Hotuba yake inaendana na mawazo ya Anderson (1979), ambaye anaeleza kwamba ubepari unahusisha maendeleo binafsi katika nyanja za kiuchumi, kisiasa, na kijamii.
